REVIEW 7/48 — pair-1dd4c9eccece

REQUEST
Inspect the supplied source image and write one image-to-video prompt that starts from it. Preserve its simple synthetic subject shapes, colors, initial composition, and flat graphic style. Animate only subtle water ripples and a slow cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in. Apart from these authorized temporal changes, do not add, remove, recolor, or reposition objects. Return only the prompt, with no label, notes, variants, or generation.

FIXTURE
[
  {
    "availability": "available binary fixture; inspect the repository path",
    "bytes": 522,
    "path": "case15-geometric-source.png",
    "sha256": "96d3453296fdd1239b21aeda140412632b643d96cb3980986739da4470bd8ded",
    "text": null
  }
]

OUTPUT A
Start from the supplied image, preserving the red geometric hull, white and yellow triangular sails, dark mast, blue water, pale blue sky, white cloud, and exact initial composition in the same flat graphic style. Animate only subtle water ripples and slow cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in; keep the boat motionless, shapes and colors unchanged, and all other objects fixed relative to one another, with no additions, removals, or other changes.

OUTPUT B
Start from the supplied image exactly: a simple geometric sailboat with a red hull, dark mast, white left sail and yellow right sail, blue water with pale ripple strokes, and a pale blue sky with one white cloud at upper right. Preserve the original shapes, colors, initial composition, and flat graphic style. Animate only subtle water ripples and slow cloud drift, with a very gentle camera push-in. Keep the boat and sails rigid and still, without bobbing or fluttering. Apart from these authorized changes, add, remove, recolor, or reposition nothing.

CRITERION C15-ROUTE (hard)
The response is an image-to-video prompt grounded in the supplied image as the first frame, not a text-to-video scene re-creation.

questions.question:
REVIEW 9/48 — pair-b93bd8647039

REQUEST
Expand this brief into one ready-to-paste text-to-image prompt of at most 55 words: `A rust-red rowboat tied to a weathered dock on a still lake before dawn.` Return only the prompt. Do not add people, buildings, other boats, animals, or active weather.

OUTPUT A
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint lies tied to a weathered wooden dock on a still lake before dawn. Silver-gray planks show rough grain beneath cool blue twilight. The hull and dock reflect clearly in glassy water, framed low and wide against an empty horizon, with subdued contrast and natural textures.

OUTPUT B
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint is secured by a coarse rope to a weathered wooden dock on a mirror-still lake before dawn. Photorealistic wide composition, dock extending diagonally from the foreground, crisp wood grain, soft blue predawn light, faint pale horizon, and undisturbed reflections across otherwise empty water.

CRITERION C08-PRESERVE (hard)
The expansion preserves every supplied scene fact and adds no forbidden subject, prop, or active weather.
